sources.title: Preparing a remote team handover
sources.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
sources.article: Before the project lead leaves for annual leave, she will hand over the client schedule to her colleague. They will go over the open tasks in a short video call and flag any deadline that may change. The colleague will keep track of new requests in the shared log and follow up with the design team if a file is missing. A clear handover helps everyone know who is responsible while the lead is away.

sources.title: Recording an urban tree survey
sources.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
sources.article: A university team will carry out a survey of trees along three busy streets. Researchers will record the species, trunk width and distance from the road at each site. In the preliminary report, they point out that young trees are concentrated near newer apartment blocks. The team will compare these observations with summer temperature readings before recommending where the city should plant more trees.
